metadata.title: क्या दस्तावेजों में सिमटा वन अधिकार अधिनियम 2006? | Is FRA 2006 limited to documents?
metadata.description:
The Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006 was introduced to empower tribal communities by granting them rights over their traditional lands and forests. However, the reality of its implementation raises crucial questions even today.

In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat, Himanshi Chaudhary delves into the recent controversies surrounding the eviction of tribals from tiger reserves and the government's new directives to ensure proper enforcement of FRA.

Learn about:
✅ The key provisions of the Forest Rights Act, 2006
✅ The challenges in implementing this law
✅ Recent incidents of forced evictions and their impact on tribal communities
✅ The role of Gram Sabhas and the legal conflicts that complicate the situation

This episode sheds light on how loopholes in the system are undermining the rights of tribal communities and what needs to be done to uphold their constitutional protections.

📌 Don't miss this critical discussion on tribal rights and justice.
